title: Reminders
whyItMatters: Tasks and lists, including personal plans.

cleanup.signOut: Sign out of the Apple Account in System Settings > Apple Account once each list is confirmed on another device.
steps: Open Reminders and check that every list also appears on a device signed in to the same account.
Quit Reminders so its data is no longer in use.
Delete the folder named in the plan if it still exists.
cleanup.risk: Lists that were never synced are lost with the folder; lists shown on another device stay in the account.
cleanup.source: Apple Support, Reminders User Guide for Mac: https://support.apple.com/guide/reminders/welcome/mac
